steps: You're going about your usual business when you discover the secretive gaze of Mistique the witch...
A pretty ordinary day, with bustling streets full of people.
My task for today is the honorable and important task of material procurement. At least, that's what I thought at first.
After I'm done, I can take advantage of the good weather, enjoy some sunshine, and laze around for a bit...
But first, I need to deal with the issue before...==W== Or, more precisely, the one behind me.
About fifteen minutes ago, I started feeling a chill creeping up my back every now and then.
It was a hungry stare—sharp, wicked, and dripping with anticipation.
Stop it, Mistique. I saw you already.
If you keep sneaking photos of me, I'm gonna start charging you a fee.
A sudden breeze, sweet-scented and wild, blows past. And just like that, a clever, charming little witch swoops down on her broom right next to me.
What, walking's not good enough for you? Or do you get your broom' maintenance done for free?
I'm a witch, I gotta look the part!
Witch Rule #1: Never run when you can fly!
Making stuff up again, huh...==W== You don't even remember what number you got to last time, do you?
Never mind all that, Boss. How'd you even notice me?
If you're gonna tail someone, even if you don't bother with disguises, at least hide that hat of yours!
Also, at least mute the shutter sound on your camera...
Oh, my! I didn't even notice that! For shame!
Curses! This has gotta be the biggest mistake of my whole career as a witch... ==W==My one regret...!
I would believe you, except you're snapping more pics as we speak...
In Nova, witches are people who fly around on brooms, snap photos, and turn stories into reports.
Most of them work for Scarlet Sights Media and follow their instructions. But of course, Mistique feels differently.
Witch Rule #2: Nothing can stand in the way of truth!
Alright, alright, I get it.==W== So, what kind of "truth" are you trying to get out of my face today?
Sheesh, there are too many eyes and ears on the street. This kind of important collaboration needs a proper, quiet place to talk it over!
I know that Mistique is full of secrets.
She rarely releases any reports through Scarlet Sight Media.
Or rather, even if she does, it won't be under her name. It's like she's gotten kicked out of the industry or something.
Anyway... Better not draw attention to ourselves out here on the street. Let's find somewhere to sit down and talk.
No sooner do we settle into the dessert shop than Mistique bursts out, buzzing with excitement. She's just picked up a "mysterious commission"!
Anyway, this one pays really well...!
Besides, it just so happens to line up perfectly with what I've been into lately!
Now I've got the perfect excuse, hehehe. ==W==I can finally take a proper photo of you, Boss!
Can you at least put the camera down while you are talking to me...?
So the commission was to take photos of me?
Exactly!==W== And it's gotta be close-up, juicy and sweet, perfectly fresh...
What am I to you? A fruit?
So, ==W==Boss!==W== Pretty please,==W== just show me mercy and obediently surrender under my camera's lens, okay?
You want my mercy or my surrender? Never mind all that...
What's in it for me, Miss Witch?
Her cheerful smile from just a moment ago freezes in place. The corner of her mouth starts to twitch.
Don't tell me—you're planning to snap your photos, vanish without a trace, and keep all that money to yourself?
She presses her fingers together, eyes darting to the side—like that's somehow gonna help her talk her way out of this.
If you want the Boss to grant your wish, you'd better be ready to pay up!
Wah!! Boss, how could you even say such a thing to me?!!!
Why are you crying? I'm the victim here.
The witch pulls her usual trick by throwing a dramatic tantrum.
Mhm, and next comes the "poor me" act, right?
Ugh... As you know, my work is super unsteady most of the time!
I work my butt off writing all those reports, and the money I make barely covers a cupcake a day!==W== Ah, no, thank you, I wasn't ordering...!
Ahem... Finally, thanks to a generous benefactor, I get a chance to make some easy money with a side gig, only to be cruelly turned down by—
This time, ==W==I shall be your generous benefactor!
Clear your schedule for the day.
You're mine for the rest of the day.
Bo-boss! Wh-what do you want me to do?!!!
The weather sure is nice today.
Perfect for snapping pictures, don't you think?
